_comment: Exact integer coefficient lists (highest power of a first) of the three blocks of the exceptional degree-two numerator Q_*(a,t), expanded in R_a = psi_1(a+1) - 1/(a+1); see eqs. (7.10)-(7.12). Since R_a > 0 and all three blocks have strictly positive coefficients for a > 0, Q_*(a,t) > 0 and hence Delta_2(a) > 0. verify_determinant.py re-derives these lists symbolically from the series definition and checks them against this file.
